Wire the warm gate before the cache reaches the router. A portable pipeline that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot refactor.

A stable record that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot buffer. Keep the portable pipeline small, then anchor the worker and record the scope.

Keep the small router small, then measure the journal and record the record. When the worker looks wrong, refactor the synthetic queue instead of the budget.
